item.title: Jr Men Academy C'ship: Ghumanhera Riser’s, Pritam Siwach Hockey Academy, S.G.P.C And SAI-Gujarat Win
item.description: Hockey India Junior Men Academy: Ghumanhera Riser’s Academy, Pritam Siwach Hockey Academy, Sonepat, S.G.P.C Hockey Academy, Sports Authority of Gujarat – Hockey Academy, Namdhari XI, and Roundglass Hockey Academy registered victories on Day 3 of the 3rd Hockey India Junior Men Academy Championship 2025 – Zone A & B in Suraj on Saturday.

item.title: MCG Pitch Controversy Leaves Cricket Australia Facing Millions After Two-Day Ashes Test
item.description: A controversial MCG pitch led to a two-day Ashes Test, heavy criticism, and an estimated $10 million revenue loss for Cricket Australia.

item.title: Premier League: Cherki's Late Winner Helps City Overcome Forest 2-1, Ends Year With A Win
item.description: Rayan Cherki: Rayan Cherki struck an 83rd-minute winner to secure a 2-1 victory for Manchester City against Nottingham Forest as Pep Guardiola ended the year 2025 on a perfect note with an eighth successive win in Nottingham on Saturday.

item.title: Head Backs Struggling Weatherald, Says 'he's Good Enough' To Play International Cricket
item.description: Travis Head: Travis Head has backed his opening partner J﻿ake Weatherald has endured a tough start to his Test career, to turn things around.

item.title: Premier League: Odegaard's First Strike Of Season, Own Goal Help Arsenal Beat Brighton 2-1
item.description: Skipper Martin Odegaard scored his first goal of the season to help Arsenal prevail over Brighton 2-1 in a home match and moved back to the top of the Premier League table in London on Saturday.

item.title: Ashes: Webster, Inglis Released From Australia Squad To Play BBL Before Sydney Test
item.description: Boxing Day Ashes Test: Australia's reserve all-rounder Beau Webster and wicketkeeper batter Josh Inglis have been released from the squad to play in the Big Bash League ahead of the Sydney Test.

item.title: Premier League: Liverpool Edge Wolves 2-1, Brentford Win 4-1, Burnley Hold Everton Goalless On A Busy Day
item.description: Gtech Community Stadium: Defending champion Liverpool closed out 2025 with a 2-1 victory over Wolverhampton Wanderers in the Premier League, moving to 32 points as they remained among the top five in the table on Saturday.

item.title: Babar, Rizwan, Afridi, Rauf Miss Out As Pakistan Name Squad For Sri Lanka T20Is
item.description: Rangiri Dambulla International Cricket Stadium: Pakistan have named their T20I squad for next month's three-match series in Sri Lanka, with several key players absent, including Babar Azam, Shaheen Afridi, Haris Rauf, and Mohammad Rizwan, who are participating in Australia's Big Bash League.

item.title: Villa Beat Chelsea To Equal Club Record With 11th Straight Win
item.description: Ollie Watkins: Ollie Watkins stepped off the bench to help Aston Villa complete a comeback victory against Chelsea in the Premier League at Stamford Bridge, equalling a club record of 11 consecutive wins in the process.

item.title: Brett Lee Inducted To Australian Cricket Hall Of Fame
item.description: The Australian Cricket Hall: Former fast bowler Brett Lee has been inducted into the Australian Cricket Hall of Fame. The announcement was made on Sunday, honouring his impressive international career characterised by exceptional pace, durability, and notable sportsmanship.
